about: Reviewed Slither false positives (scripts/slither-gate.ts). Every Medium/High finding outside this list fails CI. Entries name the detector and the function/variable, never a line. Reviewed 2026-10-19 against slither 0.11.6 on the audit-fixes branch (the audit 2026-10 triage: trusted calls behind nonReentrant, intended zero locals, timestamps). Global exclusions in slither.config.json: timestamp, weak-prng (period floors block.timestamp - block.timestamp % interval, no randomness anywhere), Low / Informational, lib/ test/ script/ src/mocks/.
